subject: Acme Corp — Audit logging & SOC 2 follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jin Lee <j.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Corp — Audit logging & SOC 2 follow-up

Hi Jin,

Great to meet you and the Acme security team on today's call — thanks for sharing the context about your SOC 2 timeline and the procurement checkpoint next week. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps: 

Summary of what we covered:
- SOC 2 status: you indicated Acme is targeting SOC 2 Type II in Q1 and needs vendor evidence for relevant controls (logging, access, change management).
- Compliance scope: you asked about GDPR/HIPAA applicability; we'll confirm our data residency and processing controls for the specific product features.
- Audit logging: key asks were admin activity logs, API request logs, exportability (CSV/JSON), retention windows, and immutability guarantees.

What we can provide right away:
- SOC 2 summary + control mappings (attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf)
- Sample audit-log schema and field list (attached: audit-logs-schema.csv)
- Export options: logs can be exported in JSON/CSV and delivered via S3 export or streamed to your SIEM via syslog/HTTPS.
- Immutability: we provide append-only write paths for audit logs and WORM export for archival; we can support signed exports for chain-of-custody if required.
- Retention: configurable per-customer; default retention is 90 days for API logs and 365 days for admin/action logs; longer retention available on Dedicated/Private plans.

Open items / next steps:
1) Please confirm the retention requirements (minimum/maximum) you need so we can propose an enrollment plan.
2) Monica (cc) will start the vendor questionnaire — we can kick off the formal security questionnaire and route evidence.
3) Tech deep-dive: propose Wed 27 Oct, 10:00–11:00 PT for our infra engineer to walk through log formats, export demo, and immutability options. Let me know if that works.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary + control mappings), audit-logs-schema.csv (sample fields + examples)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the questionnaire link and the HUBSpot M.A.P. (mutual action plan) so procurement can track milestones.

Best,
Marissa Cole

From: Jin Lee <j.lee@acme.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 17:02:13 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme Corp — Audit logging & SOC 2 follow-up

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap and the quick turnaround. A few clarifying questions from our side before we lock the MAP and schedule the tech call: 

1) Retention windows: can you confirm the minimum retention guarantee and whether retention is SLA-backed for Dedicated/Private customers? We may require 7 years for certain HIPAA-related artifacts.
2) Immutability: detail on the append-only/WORM mechanism — is it customer-controlled or platform-controlled? Any third-party notarization or signed export support?
3) Export formats: JSON is preferred. Can you provide an example of a full event (API request + auth context + response code + processing node id)? The CSV sample is helpful but JSON examples are critical for our engineering team.
4) Encryption & key management: are audit logs encrypted at rest using customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) in Private deployments?
5) Timezones & timestamps: are all logs stored in UTC and do you include sub-second precision?

Also, procurement would like a DocuSign link for the M.A.P. and the initial order form so we can track internal approvals.

If you can answer these in a short reply, we can finalize scheduling. I’m available Wed afternoon PT as backup if morning doesn’t work.

Thanks,
Jin
Security Engineering Manager
Acme Corp
j.lee@acme.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme Corp — Audit logging & SOC 2 follow-up (internal)

Quick internal draft to answer Jin's questions — feel free to copy/paste with minor edits: 

1) Retention windows: For Hosted customers default retention is 90 days (API) and 365 days (admin). For Dedicated/Private we support configurable retention up to multi-year (7+ years) and retention can be SLA-backed via contractual amendment.

2) Immutability: We maintain append-only logs in our primary store. For Dedicated/Private customers we can enable WORM exports to S3 with object-lock; we also support signed, time-stamped export bundles (SHA256 + signing key) for chain-of-custody. Notarization with a third-party timestamp authority is available on request.

3) Export formats: We generate JSON event payloads with full context (timestamp UTC ISO8601 with sub-second precision, request_id, user_id, svc_node_id, request_path, response_code, latency_ms, auth_context). Example snippet available in the audit-logs-kb link.

4) Encryption & KMS: Hosted uses platform-managed KMS by default; Dedicated/Private can be configured to use customer-managed keys (AWS KMS/Cloud HSM).

5) Timezones/timestamps: All internal stores use UTC; logs include nanosecond-resolution where supported (we typically provide microsecond precision).

I can join the tech deep-dive on Wed 27 Oct 10:00 PT. Monica — can you start the vendor questionnaire and attach the SOC 2 summary from Marissa?

- Rishi

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme Corp — Audit logging & SOC 2 follow-up

Hi Jin — thanks for the great questions. Below are concise answers and links to artifacts; happy to expand on any item during the tech call.

1) Retention: Hosted defaults (90d API / 365d admin). Dedicated/Private: configurable up to multi-year (including 7 years) and can be contractual/SLA-backed.
2) Immutability: Append-only write paths internally. For stronger guarantees we provide WORM exports to your S3 with object-lock and signed export bundles (SHA256 + signed manifest). We can also arrange notarization if you require third-party timestamping.
3) Export formats & example event (JSON): attached audit-logs-schema.csv includes field names; full JSON example is available here: https://rbw-docs.internal/redwood/audit-logs-kb (public link for Acme during evaluation). Example fields: timestamp_utc, request_id, user_id, service_node_id, api_path, http_status, latency_ms, auth_method, session_id, raw_request_body_hash.
4) Encryption & KMS: Hosted = platform-managed KMS. Dedicated/Private = support for customer-managed keys (AWS KMS / Cloud HSM).
5) Time & precision: UTC timestamps with microsecond precision (nanosecond support where underlying host supports it).

Attachments reattached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, audit-logs-schema.csv
DocuSign (M.A.P & initial order form): https://docusign.net/acme/redwood-map-ACME-2026-045

If procurement needs any additional evidence prior to the call (e.g., SOC 2 report or pen test summary), we can route via the vendor questionnaire — Monica will start that this morning.
